line: G5, spreading blue hundreds call it peacock
vault_lines: G5, spreading blue hundreds call it peacock
meaning: The G5 is a Gulfstream G500 business jet that comes equipped with two Rolls-Royce BR710 engines. It can fly long distances without refueling making it very popular for those who can afford. The price for a G5 starts at $5 million but can reach as high as $72 million depending on customizations. Kodak is saying that as he drops money in denominations of $100, the presence of the blue security ribbon on the bill will resemble the blue feathers of a peacock as a metaphor for the wings of the G5.

vault_lines: Best believe we gon' hit somethin' up (I'ma slide for my niggas)
meaning:
This song is heavily inspired by Young Thug’s “Givenchy”, both songs have a Birdman intro on it, many flows and cadences were reused by YB on this song.

Thug is one of YB’s favorite artists, so he was most likely just paying homage throughout the whole song.

It should also be noted that this song was recorded while he was working on his debut album “Until Death Call My Name”, around the same time that he adopted flows and got heavily inspired by Thugger.
